label: BRFSS Tobacco and Alcohol Use
description: Cigarette use: the two questions the shared smoking status derives from, the status, the agency's computed status, e-cigarette use; alcohol: days drinking, average drinks and binge occasions in the past 30 days. Members: Smoked at Least 100 Cigarettes (SMOKE100); Frequency of Days Now Smoking (SMOKDAY2); Smoking Status; Computed Smoking Status (_SMOKER3); Current E-cigarette Use (ECIGNOW2); Days in Past 30 Had Alcoholic Beverage (ALCDAY4); Average Alcoholic Drinks per Day in Past 30 (AVEDRNK3); Binge Drinking Occasions in Past 30 (DRNK3GE5).
